key_catalyst: Microsoft and Meta earnings after the close amid peak AI-capex skepticism, compounded by an accelerating semiconductor/AI rotation
reasoning: QQQ has fallen four straight sessions on an intensifying AI-capex scrutiny complex, and today's two biggest index holdings (MSFT, META) report after the close under the exact lens that sank Alphabet (-7%) and Tesla (-14.5%) on 07-23/07-24 even on revenue beats. The semiconductor selloff that began 07-28 on China's DUV breakthrough is accelerating (MU -8.9%, AMD -8.1%, AMAT -7.8%) with the AI-to-value rotation broadening, and a hawkish Fed tail risk (31.5% hike odds) lands before those prints. The key catalysts are unresolved and escalating rather than absorbed, leaving asymmetric downside into the close and overnight.
